# Bubble sort
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n - i - 1):
        if a[j] > a[j + 1]:

right_idx = n

while True:

else:

if right_idx >= 0 and abs(a[right_idx] - t) < abs(a[right_idx + 1] - t):
    right_candidate = a[right_idx]
else:
    right_candidate = a[right_idx + 1]

if abs(a[left_idx] - t) < abs(a[right_idx] - t):
    print(left_candidate)
